fix: Super Series: repo-based anchor tracking + 'Part N' banner titles
changes: bot/src/index.js runSuperQueueSweep: discovers active anchors by scanning the GitHub repo (listJobIds + probing jobs/<id>/super-plan.json) instead of the D1 task_options super_series_anchor flag; isSuperSeriesAnchor() added; superQueueTick accepts preloaded options and no longer writes/clears the D1 anchor flag
bot/src/super_series.js sliceSuperPart: guarantees the sliced part's title carries 'Part N' (appends ' — Part N' when the authored title lacks it), mirroring ordinary Series Mode banner convention
pipeline/plan/super_series.py slice_part: identical 'Part N' guarantee (validators/slicers stay 1:1, pinned by pipeline/tests/test_super_series.py)
D1 task_options/setTaskOptions/getTaskOptions are otherwise untouched (halt-notify bookkeeping still uses task_options; labels/announcements/clone-jobs unchanged)
migration: Live D1 checked 2026-09-13 via Cloudflare API: task_options has 5 rows, ZERO with super_series_anchor=true => no in-flight Super Series anchors; no migration step required.
app_impact: The Android app can now start a working Super Series purely by writing jobs/<anchor>/super-plan.json (+ the ordinary stage-a-request.json) to the repo; the existing per-minute cron sweep picks it up with no bot-only step and no app->D1 dependency.
